name: 本体约束UIE式精简抽取模型
implementation: prompt-conditioned 2-layer Transformer with start/end span heads; UIE-style compact structural reproduction, NOT official UIE pretrained weights
source: Chinese template summaries generated from actual Volve monthly table facts; programmatic exact-span labels

split.policy: documents/time split; different templates by split; all schema prompts of a document remain together; train-only char vocabulary

validation.protocol: one predicted span per schema prompt, exact start/end match; all prompts remain grouped by document/time split

test.protocol: one predicted span per schema prompt, exact start/end match; all prompts remain grouped by document/time split

limitations: Not an official pretrained UIE checkpoint; small trained structural reproduction.
298 programmatically generated template documents, not independently annotated real reports.
Span exact-match on templates does not establish free-form production report extraction performance.
Frozen held-out predictions, not live browser inference.
Ontology constraint here is a closed entity/relation prompt schema; full OWL axiom reasoning is not implemented.
Final exact-span F1 remains ~0.332 on held-out generated templates; require manual review, not unattended extraction.
